subject_description: a chibi female assassin with short brown hair, a purple headband with long tails, a black face mask, black and purple spiked armour, long torn purple cloth tails and a katar punch-dagger on each hand
initial_pose: standing side-on facing right, arms at her sides, the katar blades pointing down
description: a fierce, powerful katar combo facing right: she drops into a low fighting stance, then a hard LEFT punch-stab thrusting the katar blade straight forward at full arm's length with her whole body lunging in, pulls it back, then a hard RIGHT punch-stab even further forward with a big step and her body twisting into it, the headband tails and cloth tails whipping with each blow, then she snaps back to her stance. Very fast, snappy, heavy hits, each thrust held for a moment at full reach. Side view facing right in every frame, she stays on the same spot. No effects, no slash trails, no dust.
